decisions.reason: The adjustable quarter-pallet display is a low-cost catalog variant close to the core offer, and there is no evidence yet that its value will not be realized, so keeping the option open remains cheap.
The pegboard-back display uses existing cardboard capabilities and costs little to keep listed, but the firm already dropped similar variants, so the risk of pruning is moderate rather than high.
The standard quarter-pallet display is a core format with steady demand and negligible holding cost, so there is no case for abandoning it.

The wooden pallet lies outside the core paper business and costs more to sustain, but after the 2020-2021 disruptions its value as a diversification option is still unresolved, so it stays open for now under closer scrutiny.
